mechanism_inventory: access-control mismatch on receiveFromBridge (onlyExecutor guard — who/what is the executor, can it be spoofed?)
wrong value bridged vs swapped: bridge() sends swapParams.amountIn to router but transfers amt2Bridge from caller — if these differ, funds lost or over-approved
missing authorization / caller validation in bridge(): onlyUtb restricts caller but payload encodes arbitrary target/paymentOperator/refund supplied by msg.sender
token approval left on router after partial execution (dangling allowance)
external-call failure / DoS: gasIsEth branch passes no ERC-20 but router.bridgeWithPayload still receives swapParams.amountIn
victim accounting direction: receiveFromBridge pulls swapParams.amountIn from msg.sender (the executor), not from an internal balance
precision / normalization edge: amt2Bridge vs swapParams.amountIn mismatch — two quantities from different decode paths, no assertion they match

selected_mechanisms.root_cause: In bridge(), amt2Bridge tokens are transferred from msg.sender and approved to the router, but router.bridgeWithPayload() is called with swapParams.amountIn (decoded from postBridge.swapPayload) as the amount. If swapParams.amountIn != amt2Bridge, the router bridges less than pulled (user overpays, remainder locked) or attempts to bridge more than approved (revert, DoS).
selected_mechanisms.attacker_model: Any UTB caller who can craft SwapInstructions such that swapParams.amountIn < amt2Bridge. No privileged role beyond being a UTB user.
selected_mechanisms.exploit_path: 1. Attacker calls UTB with postBridge.swapPayload encoding swapParams.amountIn=X and amt2Bridge=Y>X. 2. bridge() transfers Y and approves Y to router. 3. router.bridgeWithPayload called with amount=X. 4. Y-X locked in DecentBridgeAdapter with no withdrawal mechanism. Alt: amountIn>amt2Bridge causes approve(amt2Bridge) then router pulls more — reverts.
selected_mechanisms.who_loses: User: excess tokens (Y-X) locked in the adapter with no recovery path.
selected_mechanisms.who_gains: Nobody fungibly; tokens permanently locked (or DoS).
selected_mechanisms.why_carried: Direct fund-loss/lock path; amt2Bridge vs swapParams.amountIn two distinct quantities with no enforced equality. High (conditional on caller-controlled payload divergence).

selected_mechanisms.root_cause: receiveFromBridge() calls IERC20(swapParams.tokenIn).transferFrom(msg.sender, address(this), swapParams.amountIn) where msg.sender is the executor (onlyExecutor). swapParams is attacker-controlled cross-chain payload. If the executor has a standing approval for any token, an attacker can craft a cross-chain payload with tokenIn=victimToken, amountIn=large to drain the executor's balance into the adapter, then approve(utb, large) and call IUTB(utb).receiveFromBridge with attacker-controlled target/payload.
selected_mechanisms.attacker_model: Attacker who can submit a cross-chain message arriving at receiveFromBridge with arbitrary postBridge.swapPayload. onlyExecutor restricts the direct caller, but payload content (tokenIn, amountIn) is not independently verified.
selected_mechanisms.exploit_path: 1. Attacker on source chain calls UTB->bridge() encoding tokenIn=token the executor approved, amountIn=large. 2. Message delivered; executor calls receiveFromBridge with attacker payload. 3. transferFrom(executor, adapter, large) drains executor. 4. approve(utb, large) then receiveFromBridge with attacker target/payload executes arbitrary downstream action.
selected_mechanisms.who_gains: Attacker via downstream receiveFromBridge with attacker-controlled payload/paymentOperator.
selected_mechanisms.why_carried: Payload content fully attacker-controlled from source chain; executor approval model creates a drain path. Different actor (executor) / state (executor balance) than mechanism 1. Potentially Critical.

unresolved_mechanisms.mechanism: Dangling ERC-20 approval after failed bridgeWithPayload
unresolved_mechanisms.source_evidence: approve(router, amt2Bridge) before external call with no try/catch and no reset on failure.
unresolved_mechanisms.unresolved_question: Does router.bridgeWithPayload consume the full approval atomically, or can a revert leave residual allowance exploitable by router/front-runner? Needs router source.
unresolved_mechanisms.who_loses: Adapter (holds tokens with standing approval to router).
unresolved_mechanisms.who_gains: Router or front-runner if approval exploitable.

unresolved_mechanisms.mechanism: gasIsEth=true branch: router.bridgeWithPayload called with swapParams.amountIn even though no ERC-20 pull occurs
unresolved_mechanisms.source_evidence: the if(!gasIsEth) block is the only token-pull path; the router call is unconditional with amountIn regardless.
unresolved_mechanisms.unresolved_question: Does the router handle gasIsEth=true correctly (msg.value instead of ERC-20 pull)? Needs router source.

rejected_mechanisms.mechanism: Unauthorized direct call to receiveFromBridge bypassing onlyExecutor
rejected_mechanisms.rejecting_source_fact: receiveFromBridge has onlyExecutor (BaseAdapter). Only the designated executor can call it directly.
rejected_mechanisms.why_unexploitable: A random EOA cannot call it directly; the attack requires being/compromising the executor — privileged precondition for the direct-call vector.

impact_direction.attacker_receives: Potentially via downstream receiveFromBridge with attacker payload/paymentOperator; tokens drained from executor routed through attacker swap target.
impact_direction.attacker_preserves: Attacker's own funds not at risk in the payload-manipulation vector.
impact_direction.victim_loses: User loses excess tokens locked in adapter (mechanism 1); executor loses token balance drained by attacker cross-chain payload (mechanism 2).
impact_direction.invariant_violated: Cross-chain value conservation: tokens pulled on source != tokens bridged; payload not authenticated against actual bridged amount.
impact_direction.not_self_funded_or_dust_or_admin_or_timi: Mechanism 1 affects any UTB user with divergent amounts; mechanism 2 affects executor holdings via permissionless cross-chain message crafting; no admin/self-funding/dust.
